protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; the details below are the source's own statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Oral capsule convention: 1–2 capsules once or twice daily with food for about 30 days, repeated 2–3 times yearly. Manufacturer convention, not a regimen established in a clinical trial; no reconstitution.

schedule.description: Once or twice daily with food; repeat 2–3 times/year.
